description: Search Naver — integrated, web, images, news, videos and blog posts, plus suggestions. Zero-config, no API key, no login.
long_description:
Naver Search MCP gives an AI agent access to every major Naver search vertical. Naver indexes Korean-language content — local shops, blogs, community posts, domestic news — far more deeply than general-purpose engines, which makes this the right tool for any question about Korea.

Results are read from the same server-rendered mobile pages the official Naver app displays. There is no API key to obtain, no account to create and no configuration file to edit: download, run, done.

## Verticals
- **통합검색 (Integrated)** — subject sections in page order
- **웹문서 (Web)** — external web documents, paginated
- **이미지 (Images)** — original image URLs recovered from behind the thumbnail proxy
- **뉴스 (News)** — Korean news with publisher and publish time
- **동영상 (Videos)** — videos across YouTube and other hosts
- **블로그 (Blog)** — Naver Blog posts
- **자동완성 (Suggestions)** — autocomplete keywords
